context:
You asked for a place that keeps failed commands for later review. Banchi already has one: every send to TCGplayer writes a receipt before it starts and updates it at each step. Pricing and Home show the receipts, a failed or unclear one stays until you dismiss it, and sessions can read them. The take-off is being built as one of these receipts.
What is missing: nothing lists a take-off you owe but have not pressed yet.

options.gain: One log for every write to TCGplayer, already built and readable by sessions.
options.how: The press sits on the pulled copy's row. Each try writes a send receipt; a failure stays on the Pricing and Home send card with Try again until dismissed.
options.label: Every take-off is a send receipt
options.lose: A failure shows on Pricing and Home, not where you pulled. A take-off you never pressed is listed nowhere.

options.gain: Works later without a sign-in. One press for many pulls.
options.how: Pulling a live card records the take-off as owed. The Pricing send card lists owed and failed take-offs, with one press for all of them.
options.label: An owed list on Pricing
options.lose: The listing stays live until you press, so the card can sell meanwhile.

options.gain: Seamless when it works, and nothing is lost when it does not.
options.how: The pull receipt offers the press at once. Anything not pressed, or failed, lands on the owed list on the Pricing send card. Every try is a send receipt.
options.label: Press at the pull, owed list behind it
options.lose: The most to build. Two places show the same take-off.

ref: PR 965 (master-set spec), item 13 (one press on the pull receipt)
title: Where do master-set take-offs and their failures live?
why: It gives you the press that confirms the take-off went out, plus the backlog of failed commands you asked for, on the log that already exists.
